shared: Gold carries over, so the Hive grows on gold you keep and the Carnival on gold you spend.
differ: How gold pays out: a little every 3 coins, all-or-nothing turns, or a different number per card.

takes.label: Every coin pays twice
takes.line: Saving pays per 3 coins added, not for a bank held; those coins pay again when spent, and units copy others' triggers.
takes.look_if: units that grow while held in hand, or copy others' triggers

takes.label: Save, then splurge
takes.line: A strict two-turn rhythm: keep gold one turn, spend double your base gold the next; Gate Guard stings for your whole bank.
takes.look_if: a clear on-off rhythm with one easy number to count

takes.label: Balancing the books
takes.line: Spending cards each fire once at their own number, making each last coin a sum; one pays most when spent matches held.
takes.look_if: a puzzle of hitting exact gold numbers, coin by coin
